latestVersion.changelog:
bookforge-prospecting-objective-setter v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Prospecting Objective Setter skill.
- Applies the Four Objectives framework to tailor prospecting call/email objectives for any sales situation.
- Generates a written Objective Call Plan mapping primary, secondary, and tertiary objectives to prospect tiers.
- Supports SDRs, BDRs, and sales reps in both inside and outside sales scenarios.
- Inputs include sale complexity, sales channel, prospect qualification, territory ramp-state, and buying-window status.
